lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd8In4Cu4 (reduced formula Nd2InCu) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and In each adopt a tetrahedral environment with four Nd neighbors, while Nd is coordinated by four Cu and four In neighbors, all with a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cu and In tetrahedra, corner-sharing between like tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Nd-centered eight-vertex polyhedra.
